_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 63: 7-13 April 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says that on July the 6th of 2014 in the middle of the night the Lord took him and he saw the man who looks like the Antichrist, that he has tried to find him time and time again, and that everybody asks what he looked like.
mentions.quote: The man that looks like the Antichrist
mentions.falsify_match: A figure matching the description emerging.
mentions.falsify_miss: None in twelve years. He says himself he has been looking for the man that whole time without finding him.

mentions.claim_text: He lists the droughts, the wars and rumours of wars, the pestilence and plagues coming and the five shakings the Lord told them about, and says of the president that he will not make this if they do not pray.
mentions.quote: President Trump won't make this if you don't pray
mentions.falsify_match: The president failing to complete the term.
mentions.falsify_miss: He completes it, which is credited to the prayer. The starkest version yet of the survival material.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if you gain the whole world and lose your soul, or your marriage, who cares, that they may have the character to handle it because God gave it to them but that does not mean you do or that you are ready, and that maybe the Lord sees something in you.
mentions.quote: If you can gain the whole world and lose your soul
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it doubles as an explanation for why a promised increase has not arrived: you were not ready.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says robbery, that it is the rest of it and he sees it, that it starts this May, and yields.
mentions.quote: Robbery. Starting this the May
mentions.falsify_match: A rise in robbery from May.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Fifth thing now hung on May, and no place is named.

mentions.claim_text: He congratulates someone and says he believes they will have a good healthy baby and a long healthy pregnancy with no miscarriages and nothing going wrong, and that it is interesting.
mentions.quote: you'll have a long healthy good healthy pregnancy. No miscarriages
mentions.falsify_match: The pregnancy going to term without complication.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Only the family can report either way, and only good outcomes tend to come back.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know how else to describe it but a lot of people try to ride on the tailwind, that he wants to be a trailblazer out there, and that they may be a pioneer worker with stones all around them.
mentions.quote: a lot of people who try to ride on the tailwind
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He quotes being told there is no call on their life and nothing there for them, answers that they may feel God told them, says he cannot count how many times he was told that and it may still be that way now, and that a lot of people may not see it but Jesus does.
mentions.quote: I don't see the call on your life. There's nothing there for you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it inoculates against rejection by anyone in a position to assess the claim.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He points to the Red Cross runner on April the 20th and says it is during this timeframe, and notes the Boston Marathon starts all next week and runs for several days with several different kinds of events.
mentions.quote: It's on April the 20th. the Boston Marathon starts all next week
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at the Boston Marathon.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The marathon is picked because it falls in the anniversary window rather than from anything shown, and it has its own history.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks about discernment and says they may not have an Ivy League education but somebody with some smarts who says they have been with Jesus today and he told them to tell you this, and that it would witness with what he heard.
mentions.quote: it would witness with what he heard
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the confirmation standard he uses: agreement between two people who already agree.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they are intimidated by the anointing they are seeing and are going to throw javelins at these young people and dry up the well, saying they do not want that in their church because they are insecure about their own relationship.
mentions.quote: they're going to try to throw javelins at these young people
mentions.falsify_match: Young ministers being pushed out of established churches.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The Saul and David image again, with the older generation cast as the threat.

mentions.claim_text: He calls it very sad, names spiritual intimidation and spiritual insecurity and says a lot of people are insecure, and that the Lord said it has gone on way too long, voicing the objection that they carry more anointing and I do not want to lose my church to them.
mentions.quote: Spiritual intimidation. Spiritual insecurity. it has gone on way too long
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a judgment about other ministers' motives.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: They discuss what he looked like with a little grey hair, he says they will see where that goes and maybe there will be another one, that it is 2027 and the Lord said so, and asks why the Lord is telling them about this.
mentions.quote: Maybe there'll be another one. It's 2027, the Lord said
mentions.falsify_match: Another one of whatever is meant, in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. What another one refers to is not stated in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will show them quickly before they jump in the river and does not want to take a lot of their time, reads that the FBI warns Iranian hackers may be targeting critical US water and energy systems, and asks what he told them.
mentions.quote: FBI warns Iranian hackers may be targeting critical US water and energy systems
mentions.falsify_match: A real and dated federal warning offered as fulfilment of the water infrastructure prayers. Both the warning and his earlier tellings are checkable.
mentions.falsify_miss: The earlier tellings do not name water and energy systems or Iran.

mentions.claim_text: He notes his light went out and they will have to buy a new one, asks whether they know what happened to that man, is told he saw him, and they work out that it got pulled, joking that the light is a miracle.
mentions.quote: I told you I saw him. It got pulled on
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: an aside about a figure and a piece of equipment failing mid-broadcast.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he will be there for them just as he is praying for them now, that he believes today is their day for change, and asks them to repeat a simple prayer after him and mean it with all their heart.
mentions.quote: I believe today is your day for change
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that his mercy is there and prays that he would tell the FBI, the sheriff's departments and Homeland Security, whoever may be watching these major events from Coachella onward, that his hand is on them.
mentions.quote: watching these major events from Coachella on
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at a large festival or gathering in that season.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to the prayer. A named event with no act attached, the same shape as the venue prayers.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was praying and talking to the Lord about it and that he took the puzzle pieces of everything they have been praying over since about October and started putting them together, showing where they are in the valley of decision concerning the president.
mentions.quote: he took the puzzle pieces of everything that we have been praying over since October
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it describes the method plainly: the separate pieces are assembled afterwards into a picture.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says to be a parrot is dangerous while to mirror is acceptable, and reports the Lord saying people may parrot him but he is to stand alone and say what he is told to say with accuracy and boldness with the visions given him, and that he will see it in the news.
mentions.quote: Say what I tell you to say with accuracy and boldness
mentions.falsify_match: The visions appearing in the news afterwards, which is the accuracy claim in its testable form.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not appear.

mentions.claim_text: He says it may come and it will come, a greater and greater flow and a greater restoration, to the ones who are sold out to him and looking toward him.
mentions.quote: a greater greater flow and a greater restoration to the ones that are sold out
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the condition means a missing restoration shows insufficient devotion.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that when the Supreme Court came against the tariffs he saw Trump saying it is time to do plan B, and that he said that was war, that this was clear back in February before they struck Iran, and that he told them in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: When the Supreme Court came against the tariffs, I saw plan B
mentions.falsify_match: A February telling in this corpus linking an adverse tariff ruling to war, and both events since. This is the strongest fulfilment claim in the batch and both halves are checkable.
mentions.falsify_miss: The February telling does not say it, or the sequence does not match.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether the number is king after that, notes that Ukraine struck one of Russia's largest oil refineries in the middle of the night two nights ago, and says this is concerning agenda 2030.
mentions.quote: Ukraine in the middle of the night two nights ago struck Russia's largest oil refineries
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a dated news event read out and then attached to the agenda claim.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reads a headline that the Prime Minister faces backlash after calling Muslims the face of modern Britain, says this is the agenda 2030, and refers back to seeing them in Germany making sacrifices to Satan to conjure something up.
mentions.quote: I said this is the agenda 2030
mentions.falsify_match: A political row read as evidence of a coordinated programme.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The headline is a real one and the reading of it is the claim.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told to pray over Minnesota for a red wave there and a rising up of people who are fed up, says he could still see going into November and was praying into the election, and that the Lord said you can win the Senate.
mentions.quote: The Lord said, You can win the Senate
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans holding the Senate.
mentions.falsify_miss: They lose it. Note the shift: five tellings said the Senate flips blue, and this says it can be won.
